citations.quote: It’s a 40.2″ long skateboard built to skate everything. Team Rider Clark Patrick embodies the “Skate Everything” philosophy at a level that is truly inspiring. When it came time to design his pro model, versatility was the priority. The Clark is a twin kick longboard designed to handle it all, from fast freeriding and downhill runs to tricks, skateparks, and street skating. With its long, stable platform and double kick shape, The Clark bridges the gap between a traditional skateboard and a longboard. Whether you’re bombing hills, slashing curbs, skating park, or getting airborne in the street, this 40.2 inch long skateboard is built to keep up with your creativity and push your limits.
